entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • API diff requires --beforeFriendlyName and --afterFriendlyName #49720
  • Running API diff without specifying `-eattr` makes it fail to load non-existent AttributesToExclude.txt file #49719
  • dotnet test for MTP: Add test for UseAppHost=false and support this case #49718
  • dotnet format fails after installing new version of the .NET 8 SDK due to missing executable #49716
  • Print clear informational message when `launchSettings.json` is used by `dotnet test` #49713
  • Improve output of `dotnet test` with MTP #49712
  • Better error message for missing `--solution`, `--project`, `--directory`, or `--test-modules` in dotnet test #49710
  • dotnet test for MTP handling of "global" command-line options #49709

Closed

  • [WebToolsE2E][Aspire] Installing Aspire 8.0.1 throws an exception: Cannot access a disposed object System.Collections.Concurrent.BlockingCollection. #41836
  • With .NET SDK 10.0 P7, the Aspire workload manifest is available and Aspire 8 workload can be installed #49629
